verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs position the engine as "optimized for instant (typically sub-50ms) search-as-you-type experiences." Its homepage and GitHub demos show millisecond searches over millions of records (2.2M recipes, 32M songs), and it documents Search UI Components. Community users praise the "instant search queries" and see it as a good fit for instant-search behavior. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on latency benchmarks verifying the sub-50ms claim, and in-depth docs on per-keystroke/prefix-search configuration.
